interface.shortDescription: Assemble FairyGUI components and publish UI packages via the editor.
interface.longDescription: Drive the FairyGUI editor through an in-editor bridge: list assets, create components, insert objects, set properties, and publish packages byte-identical to manual publishing. Requires the bridge plugin installed in your UI project (run scripts/install.bat, see Skill) and a running editor (free version works, can be minimized).
